name: Sitka spruce
desc: Sitka Spruce (Picea sitchensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 31 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Picea sitchensis, the Sitka spruce, is a large, coniferous, evergreen tree growing to just over 100 meters (330 ft) tall, with a trunk diameter at breast height that can exceed 5 m (16 ft).
